key_insight: MARVEL improves out-of-distribution detection in imbalanced medical imaging by combining a nonlinear von Mises-Fisher classifier, margin-aware experts, and an explicit outlier expert.
clinical_relevance: This could help diagnostic AI flag unfamiliar cases for clinician review, reducing overconfident errors on rare or unseen patients.
method: Nonlinear von Mises-Fisher (NvMF) classifier learns flexible decision boundaries.
Margin-aware multi-expert setup specializes classifiers across imbalanced label regions.
An outlier expert is trained to separate inliers from outliers for stronger OOD detection.
evidence_signal: Across RFMiD, ISIC2019, and NCTCRC, the method reduced mean FPR95 by 8.45%, 13.02%, and 36.90% versus prior methods, with ablations supporting each component.
watch_item: Performance was shown on selected datasets, so real-world deployment still needs validation across broader clinical sites, scanners, and patient populations.
paper_title: MARVEL: Margin-Aware Robust von Mises-Fischer Expert Learning for Long-Tailed Out-of-Distribution Detection
